+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Hold the stdin of the integration agent servers until the agent role is set
+---
+Requested by the swissarmyhammer-75 session, after the flake of aKanbanMutationGivesOneSubscriptionEvent (initialize got methodNotFound).
+
+Cause (found in FoundationModelsACPAgent 51332f3): AgentSideConnection.init starts its read loop before it calls core.setRole. An initialize frame that is already in the stdin pipe can get methodNotFound.
+
+Both servers of IntegrationTests/LiveAgentServer have this race: graphql-tunnel-server (composed.serve(over: StdioTransport())) and live-agent-server (AgentSideConnection(stream: StdioTransport())).
+
+Scope:
+- Move the FoundationModelsACPAgent pin of LiveAgentServer to 51332f3 (the pin is local, because Package.resolved is gitignored).
+- Add a gate transport that reads nothing from the wrapped transport before release.
+- Use it in both servers, and release after the connection is built.
+- Add a deterministic test that fails when the gate is open, and that runs in CI.
+
+Acceptance:
+- [ ] Both servers hold stdin until the connection init returns.
+- [ ] A deterministic test fails when the gate does not hold.
+- [ ] The root tests and the IntegrationTests pass. Push to main, and send the commit to swissarmyhammer-75.
+
+Rule: send a design to swissarmyhammer-75 first. #bug
\ No newline at end of file
